name: Esqueleto Explosivo
review:
Esqueleto Explosivo is Thunderkick's cult classic: Enrico Mortis and his mariachi band on a 17-line Day of the Dead slot with dropping symbols, Mucho Multipliers and the Explosivo Wild.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with a 700x cap and a 96.0% RTP. Fun, charming and gentle.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
